title: Having my ex on my podcast

author: Adam Conover
description:
This week's episode gets a little personal as my guest is...my ex! Today I'm joined by cartoonist and writer Lisa Hanawalt, as we discuss autobiographical cartooning, horses, and our breakup, which has inspired our latest artistic ventures.
